relationships.subject: paclitaxel
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared with the vehicle group, the number of TRPV1-positive neurons was significantly increased in the paclitaxel group (Figure 2B).

relationships.subject: paclitaxel
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, Western blotting analysis confirmed a significant reduction in TRPM8 protein levels in DRG following paclitaxel treatment (Figure 5C).

relationships.subject: capsazepine
relationships.evidence_quote: The von Frey test demonstrated that the paclitaxel-induced decrease in PWT was reversed following i.p. injection of CPZ (30 mg/kg) (Figure 3A).

relationships.subject: TRPM8
relationships.evidence_quote: It was concluded that pre-activation of TRPM8 inhibited the activation of TRPV1.

key_findings: TRPV1 is upregulated and more active in DRG neurons in paclitaxel neuropathy, while TRPM8 expression and function decrease.
TRPM8 activation by menthol or WS-12 reduces TRPV1 responses and attenuates paclitaxel-induced mechanical pain.
